summary: Implemented Windows board Archive with a Kit root confirmation, physical-group menu archive, transient Undo and server-owned item/group recovery inventory. Native opt-in routes reuse SelectedRead/SelectedOwner authorization, archive_page, archived_groups, transition_root and transition_group without changing direct-board or existing flat reads. Undo and group Restore share one command path. Failed or uncertain results impose a read barrier; permission denial checks current access, session rejection removes recovery targets, and refresh never replays a write. Stable root-menu focus handles restore focus on cancellation. Rendering is split by surface and heading to avoid debug-stack overflows with recovery or selection visible. Documentation changes are limited to the Windows Archive workflow row and this handoff; pre-existing roadmap, runner and packet work was preserved.
